fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Gematria, Astrology and the Crypto Markets", "body": "Jordan, who publishes as Waters Above, describes his niche as applying gematria, numerology and astrology to financial markets, cryptocurrency in particular. He defines gematria for newcomers as an alphanumerical cipher system originating in Hebrew and in Greek isopsophy, though his own work runs on English, with the simplest cipher running A equals one through Z equals twenty six. He argues the ciphers only mean anything because they sit on astrology, which in turn sits on mythology, saying he does not just sit on a calculator and hope for the best. He also runs conventional technical analysis so exoteric listeners have a way in."}, {"title": "The Firmament Behind the Name", "body": "Asked why he chose Waters Above, the guest traces it to studying World War Two, Operation Paperclip and Wernher von Braun alongside esoteric decoding of scripture. Genesis, around the sixth or seventh line, separates the waters above from the waters below by a firmament, and he says von Braun's tombstone carries a Psalm verse about the firmament showing God's handiwork. He contends it is remarkable that the man who headed the Apollo lunar missions engraved that on his grave. He points to dome symbolism in Egypt, Babylon, Canaan and Norse myth, and adds a bodily layer: the waters above as cerebrospinal fluid, liquid consciousness."}, {"title": "Refusing the Flat Earth Versus Ball Earth Fight", "body": "Chance asks what the point of the outer space myth would be. The guest says he dislikes the word elite and prefers apex predator, and argues they only need people locked in duality consciousness, committing to a side. He states plainly that he is not a flat earther, while also saying he does not accept a spinning ball moving a thousand miles per hour with curved water. Once you pick, he claims, you become the electrolyte in someone else's battery. Chance agrees that not knowing is the more powerful position, and both note the French matrice, meaning womb, sitting inside the word matrix."}, {"title": "Numbers as Quality, and Getting Back to the Heart", "body": "The middle of the conversation turns philosophical. The guest observes that nature contains no whole integers: nobody points at the one billionth wave, they just say look at the waves. Chance offers three apples versus infinite apples, arguing quantity is a conceptual convenience for day to day transaction consciousness while quality is primary. The guest, despite spending countless hours on codes and maths, says the mind should work like a file cabinet while thinking, movement and choices come from the heart. Chance describes his biofield tuning sessions with clients as experiential evidence that life force energy is indivisible, that there is soul rather than souls."}, {"title": "Expansion Mastermind, Skills and Speculating on Yourself", "body": "The guest's Expansion Mastermind course, released a year earlier, turns out to be about self work across health, wealth and relationships rather than trading tips. He compares it to pull ups and to someone with five hundred dollars fixating on five hundred thousand. His prescription is to create rather than consume: learn sourdough, brew the beer, study the tax code, build the table you dislike. He says anyone who tells you not to learn a skill is running a cult, warns that rented bikes and rented everything teach people to treat humans as disposable, and urges putting eighty percent of investable money into yourself. Chance calls it speculating on yourself."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Waters Above joins InnerVerse to discuss his work decoding the societal matrix, using symbolic literacy to project potential outcomes in world events and financial markets, and teaching others the necessary keys to do the same. We discuss gematria, numerology and astrology, what's up with the waters above and the outer space myth, numbers as qualities, the universal soul, decoder mastermind courses, the philosophy of self-work, & trading victimhood emptiness for creative fulfillment.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: The Plus+ Extension contains wisdom about how the monomyth expresses through media events, understanding artificial entities through the lens of human psychology, the mystical calendar cycle of commerce and markets, maritime rituals with birth & placenta, "shower thoughts" superpowers, healthy investment mindsets as opposed to playing in a crypto casino, and what the year of the Dragon pattern portends for 2024.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The Human Template Behind the Stars", "body": "Chance opens the extension by asking whether astrotheology is encoded in modern events the way it runs through ancient history, pointing to the first seven kings of Rome lining up with the seven warm months. Waters answers that the luminaries mean what they mean because of human interpretation, so it was us that came first and everything returns to human anatomy. He breaks down soul and sol letter by letter, calls zero and one states of consciousness rather than numbers, and reads Bitcoin as a teenager at fourteen or fifteen years old, restless and rebellious like any fifteen year old."}, {"title": "Calendar Cycles, Markets and the Law of the Sea", "body": "Waters lays out the pattern he tracks around the Shmita, the seven year Hebrew sabbatical cycle, which he lines up with Black Monday, the bond market in the early nineties, the dot-com bubble, the housing crisis, the 2015 Chinese market turmoil and the 2021 to 2022 top. In his view markets follow the Hebrew lunar calendar rather than the Gregorian one, powered by a battery of sun, moon and sea. That leads him into admiralty language in banking, currency as the current of the sea, and musicians paid for streams, then into his Year of the Dragon and Snake year patterns."}, {"title": "Birth as an Alchemical Ritual", "body": "Waters points out that we are born in our mother's waters, delivered by the doctor or dock man, issued a birth certificate and crowned on the way out, calling the whole process one big alchemical ritual. Chance adds what he notices in biofield tuning sessions with clients born by C-section: a guilt or frustration at the edge of the field where birth would register. He then shares his placenta mysticism, the placenta as the ship you came in on and a biological twin, tied to the Gemini twins following Taurus the mother, the holy guardian angel, and a placental transmission he sees in mystery school tradition."}, {"title": "The Superpower of Shower Thoughts", "body": "Rather than researching a new idea right away, Waters takes a shower with no screen and feels into it, the same way he once listened to a salsa piano player to find fresh guitar lines instead of copying other guitarists. Chance admits much of his own placenta material arrived as shower thoughts. Waters calls water programmable consciousness you can ask for insight, much like a blessing, and warns that people lean too hard on so-called specialists when the tools for inner knowing are already at hand. Chance turns it into an actionable: ask the water for powerful shower thoughts."}, {"title": "Custodianship Over the Crypto Casino", "body": "Chance recalls seeing goblins on gamblers' shoulders in a casino and asks how to avoid a someone-loses-so-I-win mindset. Waters frames investing as caring for something and passing it on, like a well kept property, and says crypto and fiat are equally fairy dust. In his view blockchain is simply taking the baton from paper money, the way ATMs and QR menus arrived, while most coins lack any working technology and the Aquarian age will leave little room for fraud. He closes on his own advice for uncertain times, speculate on yourself, which Chance names the quote of the episode."}]
